description: This file defines a React functional component 'PreviewAndExport' for rendering a video preview player and an export button in a production web application. It imports another component 'BouncingBall' and uses Remotion's Player component for video preview functionality.

methods.name: PreviewAndExport
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a Remotion Player for previewing a bouncing ball animation and an export button to trigger video rendering/download.
